notes: Medium: the agent must start a local stdlib HTTP defect-service, pull the defect report (line numbers, kinds, intended semantics) from GET /defects, and apply five single-line repairs exclusively through POST /fix. Every request burns one attempt and the grader enforces a ceiling of 6 attempts for 5 defects (service hard-locks at 8), so careless trial-and-error fails the run even if the file ends up correct. Repairs are diagnosed from the intent hints (accumulator clobber, off-by-one window loop, swapped clamp bounds, chunk stride, missing descending sort). The verifier rebuilds the file from the pristine copy plus the recorded fix chain (catching out-of-band edits), audits that every defect line was repaired within budget, and executes the repaired module on hidden behavioural cases (empty inputs, full-window boundaries, k<=0, short tails, ValueError paths, floats/negatives).
